opening-image.name: Opening Image
opening-image.description: A visual that represents the starting point of your protagonist. This is a 'before' snapshot that will contrast with the Final Image.
opening-image.prompt: What single image or moment captures your protagonist's world before everything changes?

theme-stated.name: Theme Stated
theme-stated.description: Someone (usually not the protagonist) states the theme of the story. The protagonist doesn't understand it yet.
theme-stated.prompt: What life lesson will your protagonist learn? How can a character hint at it early on?

setup.name: Setup
setup.description: Introduce the protagonist's world, their flaws, and what needs fixing. Plant seeds that will pay off later.
setup.prompt: What is broken in your protagonist's life? What do they want vs. what do they need?

catalyst.name: Catalyst
catalyst.description: The inciting incident. Something happens that disrupts the status quo and sets the story in motion.
catalyst.prompt: What event knocks your protagonist out of their ordinary world?

debate.name: Debate
debate.description: The protagonist hesitates. Should they accept the call to adventure? This is the last chance to turn back.
debate.prompt: Why would your protagonist resist the call? What fears or obligations hold them back?

break-into-two.name: Break Into Two
break-into-two.description: The protagonist makes a choice and enters Act Two—the 'upside-down world' that contrasts with Act One.
break-into-two.prompt: What decision does your protagonist make that commits them to the journey?

b-story.name: B Story
b-story.description: A secondary storyline begins, often involving a love interest or mentor who helps the protagonist learn the theme.
b-story.prompt: Who will teach your protagonist the theme? What relationship develops alongside the main plot?

fun-and-games.name: Fun and Games
fun-and-games.description: The promise of the premise. This is why the audience came—deliver the goods here.
fun-and-games.prompt: What scenes showcase your concept at its fullest? What's the 'trailer moment' material?

midpoint.name: Midpoint
midpoint.description: A false victory or false defeat that raises the stakes. The protagonist is no longer just playing—now it's real.
midpoint.prompt: Does your protagonist get what they want (false victory) or lose badly (false defeat)? How do stakes escalate?

bad-guys-close-in.name: Bad Guys Close In
bad-guys-close-in.description: External pressures mount and internal flaws resurface. The team fractures. Things get worse.
bad-guys-close-in.prompt: How do antagonistic forces tighten the noose? What internal doubts resurface?

all-is-lost.name: All Is Lost
all-is-lost.description: The lowest point. Often involves a 'whiff of death'—literal or metaphorical. The old self must die.
all-is-lost.prompt: What is taken from your protagonist? What loss forces them to rock bottom?

dark-night-of-the-soul.name: Dark Night of the Soul
dark-night-of-the-soul.description: The protagonist mourns, reflects, and eventually finds clarity. This is the moment before transformation.
dark-night-of-the-soul.prompt: How does your protagonist process their loss? What realization finally breaks through?

break-into-three.name: Break Into Three
break-into-three.description: Armed with new understanding, the protagonist chooses to act. A and B stories often combine here.
break-into-three.prompt: What solution emerges from the protagonist's reflection? How does the B Story inform the answer?

finale.name: Finale
finale.description: The climactic sequence where the protagonist applies their lessons, defeats the antagonist, and transforms.
finale.prompt: How does your protagonist prove they've changed by facing the final challenge?

finale-gathering.name: Gathering the Team
finale-gathering.description: The protagonist rallies allies, gathers resources, and prepares for the final push.
finale-gathering.prompt: Who joins the protagonist? What do they need to assemble before the climax?

finale-executing.name: Executing the Plan
finale-executing.description: The initial plan is put into action. Early signs suggest it might work.
finale-executing.prompt: What's the protagonist's strategy? How does it begin to unfold?

finale-high-tower.name: High Tower Surprise
finale-high-tower.description: A twist! The plan fails or the antagonist reveals a hidden advantage. All seems lost again.
finale-high-tower.prompt: What unexpected obstacle throws the plan into chaos?

finale-dig-deep.name: Dig Deep Down
finale-dig-deep.description: The protagonist must reach inside and find their true strength—the lesson learned from the theme.
finale-dig-deep.prompt: How does the protagonist summon what they've learned to push through?

finale-new-plan.name: Execution of New Plan
finale-new-plan.description: Using their newfound wisdom, the protagonist executes a new approach and achieves victory.
finale-new-plan.prompt: What does the protagonist do differently this time? How does their change enable success?

final-image.name: Final Image
final-image.description: A visual that represents the ending—the 'after' snapshot that contrasts with the Opening Image.
final-image.prompt: What image shows how your protagonist and their world have transformed?
